notes: Customer: mid-market B2B ecommerce SaaS that powers merchandising for regional retailers.
Primary ask: improve search recall and commercial relevance via a reranking endpoint that can run model-based features on top of existing BM25 signals.
Constraints: p95 latency target ~150-200ms for rerank path, peak throughput ~80-120 qps, cost sensitivity important but willing to pay for predictable SLAs.

POC approach: offline eval sets + holdout A/B. Ran offline scoring with Redwood rerank endpoint (hosted) and compared to current production scorer — saw +6.2% CTR lift in labeled eval set, +2.1% live uplift in 2-week incremental test (10% traffic).
Notation from demo: 'Need deterministic fallbacks when model unavailable' (quote from Head of Search). Interested in automatic fallback to cheaper model variant and region routing.
Security: require SSO SAML, audit logs, optional KMS for encryption at rest; legal asked about data residency for EU storefronts.

Technical notes: they shipped a small feature set to POC — dense signals + handcrafted features. Interested in Redwood's offline scoring API so they can run nightly rescoring to compute features for downstream analytics.
SE feedback: Diego recommends Dedicated for predictable tail latency and KV cache locality for their long contexts; propose 2 GPU reserved pool + autoscale policy for Black Friday windows.
Pricing asks: committed monthly vs pay-as-you-go comparison; want unit economics for offline scoring jobs (bulk token costs) vs live rerank requests.
Next-phase asks: realistic SLOs for p99 and p95, a sample SLA for Dedicated, and a draft contract term sheet for mid-market package.
